name: Social Media Content Pipeline
description: Build a complete social media content strategy: define pillars and audience, write 5 ready-to-post pieces, optimize with hashtags and timing, and produce a 7-day calendar.

steps.name: Content Strategy
steps.instructions: Based on the brand, product, or topic in the workflow input, define a social media content strategy. Specify: 3-4 content pillars (themes), target audience persona, recommended posting cadence per platform (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram), tone of voice guidelines, and 5 content ideas per pillar.

steps.name: Post Copywriting
steps.instructions: Using the content strategy from step 1, write 5 complete social media posts. For each post: provide LinkedIn version (professional, 150-200 words), Twitter/X version (under 280 characters), Instagram caption (engaging, 100-150 words with line breaks). Vary the content pillars and formats (tips, stories, questions, announcements).

steps.name: Hashtag & Engagement Strategy
steps.instructions: Using the content from step 2, optimize each post for engagement. For each of the 5 posts provide: 5-10 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and niche), best posting time recommendation, a call-to-action suggestion, and one engagement hook (question, poll idea, or conversation starter).

steps.name: Content Calendar
steps.instructions: Using the 5 posts from step 2 and the optimization from step 3, create a 7-day social media content calendar in Markdown table format. Columns: Day, Platform, Post Preview (first 20 words), Hashtags, Posting Time, Content Pillar. Distribute posts evenly across the week with strategic spacing.
